topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: At first, the news felt like a sudden shadow over the day, the surprise party I had been looking forward to, now silent and empty. But as I let the idea settle, a quiet possibility emerged. Perhaps this is an opportunity, a blank canvas of time that suddenly stretches before me, free and open. I can craft this space with my own hands, fill it with what truly speaks to my heart. It’s not often we’re given a second chance to design a moment that was meant to be a surprise. This could be something even more meaningful, a gentle reminder to cherish the unexpected twists that life offers, inviting us to write our own endings.
